post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry options event-distance cutoffs, wider earnings windows, put/call ratio, IV skew, liquidity, spread, zero-bid count, open interest, top-N, hold, cooldown, notional, or threshold variants on this same exp026 forward ledger.
